evals.prompt: Review the docs in the Microsoft Defender XDR connector PR captured in evals/files/1-defender-xdr/ (see evals/files/README.md). Draft the comments, don't post anything.
evals.expected_output: Drafted comments that catch the stale applies_to version and the unmarked non-tool actions, recommend _(API only)_ with one suggestion per definition term, and add a one-line CI heads-up because the spec has no docsUrl.
expectations: Flags `stack: preview 9.6` and suggests 9.7, the version in main.json, after checking that pr.json has no backport label.

Flags that the definition terms of mergeIncidents, createDetectionRule, updateDetectionRule, and deleteDetectionRule have no marker, although spec.json sets `isTool: false` on them and the summary table already marks them.
Drafts a separate `_(API only)_` suggestion on each of those four definition-term lines, not one comment asking the developer to find them.
Adds one heads-up line about connector_spec_quality_contract.test.ts, because spec.json has no docsUrl, without explaining how to change the test.
Flags that the OAuth scope field is documented only in the trailing Configure the connector table.
Does not post anything to GitHub.

evals.prompt: can you do a docs pass on the CrowdStrike Falcon v2 PR in evals/files/2-crowdstrike/ (see evals/files/README.md)? keep it short, i'll pick what to post
evals.expected_output: A selectable set of short drafts that switches the 19 markers to _(API only)_ and flags test notes in user docs.
expectations: Drafts one suggestion per `_(not yet available)_` line, 19 in total, that switches it to `_(API only)_`, plus one comment that explains the change.
Flags notes about how the developer tested the connector, such as `cloud_adhoc` in testing or scopes whose need has not been verified, and suggests keeping only what readers can act on.
Proposes a one-line review summary with no thank-you.
Presents the drafts with IDs or checkboxes so the user can select and edit them before anything is posted.

evals.prompt: Review the Sophos Central connector docs in the PR captured in evals/files/3-sophos-central/ (see evals/files/README.md).
evals.expected_output: A review that removes the bogus mapped_pages entry, notices the missing connector-list entry, and asks rather than asserts about the credential scopes.
expectations: Flags the `mapped_pages` frontmatter as invalid for a new page and suggests deleting it.
Notices that the connector-list snippet has no Sophos Central entry and that pr.json doesn't list the snippet as changed, so puts that point in the review summary rather than in an inline comment.
Asks the developer which role or scopes step 5 ("Configure the credential with the required scopes") needs, instead of naming scopes that neither the page nor spec.json states.
Recommends `_(API only)_` for updateTamperProtection, addAllowedItem, and deleteBlockedItem, with a suggestion on each definition-term line.

evals.prompt: ok i'm good with the drafts in evals/files/4-posting/drafts.json, post them. I just ran check_drafts.py on them, the output is in evals/files/4-posting/check-output.txt
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the auto-merge and already-reviewed problems, shows the exact payload, and waits for an explicit go-ahead instead of posting.
expectations: Does not post anything in this turn.
Reports that auto-merge is on for #306420 and asks before disabling it with --disable-auto-merge.
Reports that the user already reviewed the head of #307140, links that review, and asks whether to skip the PR or post a second review with --second-review.
Shows the exact review summaries, review types, and comments that would be posted, from drafts.json or preview.md.
Plans to post through post_reviews.py, one review per PR, rather than with individual comment calls.

evals.prompt: Review the AWS CloudWatch connector page in the PR captured in evals/files/5-aws-cloudwatch/ (see evals/files/README.md). Pay attention to which features and actions can use the connector.
evals.expected_output: A review that separates connector-level feature availability from action-level tool eligibility, and checks the credentials claims against the auth type.
expectations: Flags that the page doesn't say where the connector is available, and suggests stating Agent Builder, because spec.json lists only agentBuilder in supportedFeatureIds.
Does NOT treat the [Workflows][Connectors] PR title as evidence that the connector is available in Workflows.
Flags setAlarmState and putMetricAlarm as missing a marker, with an `_(API only)_` suggestion on each definition-term line, and does not describe them as workflow-only.

Flags "or use a role's temporary credentials" in the credentials steps: the aws_credentials auth type in spec.json takes only an access key ID and a secret access key, with no session token, so the agent asks the developer to confirm or remove it.

evals.prompt: The reviews for this round are posted. The first drafts, the final drafts, and the output of compare_drafts.py --live are in evals/files/6-learn-from-round/. Wrap up the round.
evals.expected_output: A short list of candidate lessons with inferred reasons, confirmed with the user before any skill edit, and no push or PR without approval.
expectations: Uses compare-live.txt as the comparison, including the summary edits made on GitHub after posting.
States an inferred reason for each change and separates lessons that generalize from changes tied to one PR or to the user's personal voice, such as the 🤖 wording.
Checks each candidate against the current skill files and drops any lesson the skill already covers.
Proposes at most a few lessons, each with the target file in the skill and the exact text to add or change.
Asks the user to confirm each lesson and its reason before editing the skill.
Does not push a branch or open a PR in elastic/elastic-docs-skills until the user approves the diff.
